work_or_witness: HeroQuest Game System · Product Info; Mythical Heroes
definition: The four selectable player-hero titles in the F3649 core: Barbarian, Dwarf, Elf, and Wizard.
cultural_caution: These are game roles/titles, not named canon people or direct representations of real cultures, peoples, or professions.

supports: Lists the four heroes as Barbarian, Dwarf, Elf, and Wizard.

definition: Hasbro's description for the board-game structure in which heroes complete quests, seek treasure, and fight foes in a dungeon.
cultural_caution: A tabletop genre/mechanical label, not a narrative location or character class.

supports: Calls HeroQuest a dungeon crawl board game and summarizes its quest-and-treasure play.

definition: A play structure with one Zargon Game Master player and up to four players controlling the hero roles.
cultural_caution: Describes table roles and does not establish alliances among individually named fictional characters.

supports: Defines one Zargon Game Master and four heroes in a semi-cooperative game.

work_or_witness: HeroQuest Game System · Product Info; Limitless Replayability
definition: Scenario-based adventures; the F3649 core includes 14 quests and explicitly allows players to build their own quests and stories.
cultural_caution: A scenario framework. Player-authored quests are not automatically canonical source narrative.

supports: States that the core has 14 quests and allows players to build quests and stories.

work_or_witness: HeroQuest Game System · Product Info; Stunning Artwork
definition: Generic adversary figures and categories populating the core's maze of dark dungeons.
cultural_caution: A generic game-adversary category, never a character endpoint without a separately evidenced named individual profile.

supports: Describes monsters in the dungeon and lists 31 monster miniatures among components.
